defmodule SmartContract.ExpressionEngine do
  @moduledoc """
  Expression evaluation engine for blockchain smart contract conditions.
  Supports async evaluation of contract predicates with sandboxed execution.
  """

  defstruct [:contract_id, :state, :pending_evals, :allowed_modules]

  @allowed_modules [String, Integer, Float, Enum, Map]
  @max_eval_depth 3

  def new(contract_id) do
    %__MODULE__{
      contract_id: contract_id,
      state: %{},
      pending_evals: [],
      allowed_modules: @allowed_modules
    }
  end

  def submit_condition(engine, condition_expr, context \\ %{}) do
    task = Task.async(fn ->
      evaluate_condition(engine, condition_expr, context)
    end)
    updated = %{engine | pending_evals: [task | engine.pending_evals]}
    {:ok, updated}
  end

  def await_results(engine, timeout \\ 5000) do
    results = engine.pending_evals
    |> Enum.map(fn task -> Task.await(task, timeout) end)
    |> Enum.reverse()
    {results, %{engine | pending_evals: []}}
  end

  defp evaluate_condition(engine, condition_expr, context) do
    sanitized = sanitize_expression(condition_expr)
    case compile_and_eval(sanitized, context, engine) do
      {:ok, result} -> {:ok, result}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_expression(expr) when is_binary(expr) do
    expr
    |> String.replace(~r/System\./, "")
    |> String.replace(~r/File\./, "")
    |> String.replace(~r/Port\./, "")
    |> String.replace(~r/:os\./, "")
    |> String.replace(~r/Process\./, "")
    |> reject_dangerous_atoms()
  end

  defp reject_dangerous_atoms(expr) do
    dangerous = ["spawn", "send", "receive", "exit", "throw"]
    if Enum.any?(dangerous, &String.contains?(expr, &1)) do
      raise "Dangerous expression detected"
    end
    expr
  end

  defp compile_and_eval(expr, context, engine) do
    bindings = context |> Map.to_list()
    try do
      ast = Code.string_to_quoted!(expr)
      if ast_safe?(ast, engine, 0) do
        {result, _} = Code.eval_quoted(ast, bindings)
        {:ok, result}
      else
        {:error, :unsafe_expression}
      end
    rescue
      e -> {:error, Exception.message(e)}
    end
  end

  defp ast_safe?(_ast, _engine, depth) when depth > @max_eval_depth, do: false

  defp ast_safe?({:., _, [{:__aliases__, _, module_parts}, _func]}, engine, _depth) do
    module = Module.concat(module_parts)
    module in engine.allowed_modules
  end

  defp ast_safe?({:., _, [Access, :get]}, _engine, _depth), do: true

  defp ast_safe?({op, _, args}, engine, depth) when is_list(args) do
    safe_op?(op) and Enum.all?(args, &ast_safe?(&1, engine, depth + 1))
  end

  defp ast_safe?({op, _, args}, engine, depth) when is_atom(args) do
    safe_op?(op)
  end

  defp ast_safe?(literal, _engine, _depth)
    when is_number(literal) or is_binary(literal) or is_atom(literal), do: true

  defp ast_safe?(list, engine, depth) when is_list(list) do
    Enum.all?(list, &ast_safe?(&1, engine, depth + 1))
  end

  defp ast_safe?({left, right}, engine, depth) do
    ast_safe?(left, engine, depth + 1) and ast_safe?(right, engine, depth + 1)
  end

  defp ast_safe?(_other, _engine, _depth), do: false

  defp safe_op?(op) when op in [:+, :-, :*, :/, :==, :!=, :>, :<, :>=, :<=, :and, :or, :not, :if, :cond], do: true
  defp safe_op?(:__aliases__), do: true
  defp safe_op?(_), do: false
end

defmodule SmartContract.ContractRunner do
  alias SmartContract.ExpressionEngine

  def execute_contract(contract_id, conditions, context) do
    engine = ExpressionEngine.new(contract_id)

    engine = Enum.reduce(conditions, engine, fn cond_expr, acc ->
      {:ok, updated} = ExpressionEngine.submit_condition(acc, cond_expr, context)
      updated
    end)

    {results, _engine} = ExpressionEngine.await_results(engine)
    evaluate_contract_outcome(results)
  end

  defp evaluate_contract_outcome(results) do
    if Enum.all?(results, fn
      {:ok, true} -> true
      {:ok, val} when val != false and val != nil -> true
      _ -> false
    end) do
      {:contract_fulfilled, results}
    else
      {:contract_failed, results}
    end
  end
end
